blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visualizing intermediate representations could help us inspect the reasoning steps underlying a model output. Unified multimodal models offer this opportunity by combining understanding and generation in one architecture. Their image generators can access representations formed while processing text. We introduce the V-lens, which uses this connection to visualize a chosen token's hidden state without training a decoder. Across four diffusion-based and two purely autoregressive unified models, the resulting images reveal key intermediate concepts that connect a question to its answer even when the concepts are never named explicitly. Controlled tests show how this content changes with context, token position, and depth. We then introduce lens tuning, which supervises selected hidden states with pictures through the V-lens. Across BAGEL, SenseNova-U1, and HunyuanImage-3.0, the rate of correct visualizations of pronoun referents rises from 2-11% to 86-94%. Surprisingly, such visual supervision also improves text answers without supervising the answer tokens directly. Code is available at https://github.com/multimodal-ai-lab/V-lens.
blocks.zh: 可视化的中间表示可以帮助我们检查模型输出背后的推理步骤。 统一的多式联运模式通过将理解和生成结合起来,提供了一个机会。 他们的图像生成器可以访问处理文本时形成的表达式. 我们介绍V -Lens, 它利用这个连接 直观一个选择的 代号的隐藏状态 不训练解码器。 在整个四个基于扩散的模型和两个纯粹自递性的统一模型中,所产生的图像揭示出关键的中间概念,这些中间概念将一个问题与其答案联系起来,即使这些概念从未被明确命名。 受控测试显示此内容如何随上下文,符号位置,深度变化. 然后我们引入镜头调制,通过V-Lens来监督选定的隐藏状态. 横跨BAGEL,SenseNova-U1和Hunyuanimage-3.0,代名词的正确可视化率从2-11%上升到86-94%. 令人惊讶的是,这种视觉监督也改进了文本答案,而没有直接监督答案符号. 代码见https://github.com/multimate-ai-lab/V-lens。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: To answer On which continent does the biggest land animal live? , a model must connect the question to an elephant and the elephant to Africa. The models in correctly answer Africa without ever generating the word elephant . During the generation of their text answers, the models must therefore internally represent the concept of an elephant before shifting their representation toward the output token Africa. While prior work has developed methods to verbalize such intermediate reasoning concepts [ 13 , 18 ] , we aim for a complementary route. Motivated by human reasoning, which can draw on mental imagery [ 33 , 19 ] to solve problems, we aim to visualize them using the model’s own means of visualization. Specifically, we ask:
blocks.zh: 来回答 最大的陆地动物生活在哪个大陆? 一个模型必须将问题与大象联系起来,大象与非洲联系起来。 这些模型正确回答非洲, 因此,在生成其文本答复时,模型必须在内部代表大象的概念,然后将其表述转向产出象征的非洲。 虽然先前的工作已经制定了将这种中间推理概念[13、18]口头化的方法,但我们的目标是找到一条补充路线。 在人类推理的激励下,它能利用精神图像[33,19]来解决问题,我们的目标是利用模型自己的视觉手段来形象地看待这些问题。 具体地说,我们问:

blocks.en: Can intermediate concepts be made visible within a model’s computation without training a separate decoder?
blocks.zh: 中间概念能否在模型的计算中不培训单独的解码器而显露出来?

blocks.en: We find that the model’s own image generator can indeed visualize these concepts from text token representations in its residual stream. These visualizations offer a new way to inspect and supervise content that the text response omits.
blocks.zh: 我们发现模型本身的图像生成器能够从剩余流中的文本符号表示来真实地呈现这些概念。 这些可视化提供了检查和监督文本回复省略的内容的新方式.

blocks.en:
Unified multimodal models make this possible through their architecture. They combine understanding and generation across text and images in one system, allowing the image generator to read representations computed while understanding text. Building on this connection, we introduce the V-lens . Transformer layers maintain contextualized token representations known as hidden states [ 42 ] . We center and rescale a selected hidden state to account for differences in the average and spread of states across layers. We then insert it into a minimal drawing prompt and let the model’s own generator draw an image. This requires no decoder training. Prior work makes a model’s intermediate states interpretable as text tokens [ 29 , 4 , 18 ] . Our approach visualizes them as images and traces how these visualizations evolve during text generation. As the V-lens uses the model’s own image generator, it is not restricted to one specific generation paradigm. We show that our approach works for models that process text
and image within one shared transformer [ 45 , 39 ] , models that also use a separate set of weights during image generation [ 11 , 12 ] , and purely autoregressive generators that draw token by token [ 8 , 44 ] .
blocks.zh:
统一的多式联运模式通过它们的架构使这一点成为可能。 它们将一个系统中的文本和图像之间的理解和生成结合起来,使图像生成器能够在理解文本的同时读取计算出的表示。 在此基础上,我们介绍V -lens。 变形器层保持了被称为隐藏状态的上下文化的符号表示[42]. 我们集中并调整一个选定的隐藏状态,以说明各层次国家的平均和分布的差异。 然后插入一个最小的绘图提示, 让模型自己的生成器绘制一个图像。 这不需要解码器训练。 以前的作品使得模型的中间状态可以解释为文本符号[29, 4, 18]. 我们的方法把它们作为图像来形象化,并追踪这些视觉在文本生成过程中是如何演化的. 由于V-Lens使用该模型自己的图像生成器,它不仅限于一个特定的代数范式. 我们显示,我们的方法对处理文本的模型有效
和一个共享变压器内的图像 [45,39],在图像生成过程中同样使用一组单独重量的模型 [11,12],以及以符号表示符号的纯自递式发电机 [8,44].

blocks.en:
To assess the level of detail captured by the V-lens , we vary the context around specific text tokens, such as object references and words with two meanings. We find that the same token can yield different visualizations depending on its context, most consistently for words with two meanings.
An analysis across layers reveals that unnamed objects can be visualized at intermediate depths and fade toward the final layers in most models.
The link from a hidden state to its V-lens picture can also be trained. BAGEL [ 11 ] , SenseNova-U1 [ 12 ] , and HunyuanImage-3.0 [ 39 ] often answer reference questions correctly while the visualization of the referent shows the incorrect object. We add small adapters to the text layers and supervise the hidden state with self-generated images through the V-lens . On held-out texts, correct visualizations rise from 2% to 86% in BAGEL, 11% to 94% in SenseNova-U1, and 6% to 86% in HunyuanImage-3.0. We call this procedure lens tuning and also test it with questions in which an event changes an object’s state. Despite purely visual supervision, lens tuning improves text answers on supervised stories in Show-o2 [ 45 ] and HunyuanImage-3.0. Finally, transferring a hidden state from a lens-tuned model to the original model carries part of the correction, showing that the states we visualize are directly connected to the model’s text answers.
blocks.zh:
为了评估V-lens捕捉到的细节水平,我们围绕特定的文本符号来改变上下文,例如对象引用和有两种含义的单词. 我们发现,同样的同物可以根据其上下文产生不同的可视化,对于有两种含义的词来说最为一致.
跨层分析显示,未命名的物体可以在中间深度可视化,并在大多数模型中向最后层逐渐淡出.
从隐藏状态到其V-lens图片的链接也可以训练. 巴盖尔 [11],森特诺瓦-U1 [12],和匈奴. Image-3.0 [39] 经常正确回答参考问题,而参考者的可视化显示不正确的对象. 我们在文字层中添加小的适配器,并用通过V-lens自生成的图像来监督隐藏状态. 在被搁置的文本中,正确的可视化率在BAGEL从2%上升到86%,在SenseNova-U1中从11%上升到94%,在Hunyuanimage-3.0中从6%上升到86%。 我们称之为程序镜头调试, 尽管纯粹是视觉监督,镜头调音在Show-o2[45]和Hunyuanimage-3.0. 最后,将一个隐藏状态从一个镜头调制的模型转移到原来的模型中带有部分的校正,表明我们可视化的状态与模型的文本答案直接相连.

blocks.en: Our work makes the following three contributions: • The V-lens , which visualizes intermediate hidden states of text tokens without training a separate decoder. • Controlled tests in six unified models showing that visualizations follow a token’s context and, in five of them, reveal unnamed concepts at specific tokens and depths. • Lens tuning that uses only visual supervision through the V-lens to improve visualizations and text answers.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作作出以下三项贡献: V-lens,它可视化中间隐藏状态的文本符,而不训练单独的解码器. • 支助 在六个统一的模型中进行控制测试,显示可视化遵循一个符号的上下文,在其中五个模型中,在具体符号和深度上揭示未命名的概念. • 支助 镜头调音,通过V-lens只使用视觉监督来改进视觉和文本答案.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Prior work makes neural computations more interpretable by visualizing learned features [ 30 ] and identifying computational subgraphs (circuits) that implement specific behaviors [ 31 ] . Sparse autoencoders reconstruct activations through combinations of learned features that are often easier to interpret than individual neurons [ 21 ] . Natural language autoencoders learn to reconstruct activations through text descriptions [ 13 ] , while activation oracles learn to answer questions about them [ 22 ] .
Hidden-state lenses also aim to make intermediate computations interpretable for humans. The logit lens reads earlier states through the model’s final word prediction layer [ 29 ] , an approach also used to analyze visual tokens in vision-language models [ 28 ] . Because states at different layers can use different representations, the tuned lens first learns a linear map and offset for each layer to match the model’s final token predictions [ 4 ] . The Jacobian lens, or J-lens, uses averaged derivatives of the model’s computation to carry a state toward the final layer before reading it through the vocabulary [ 18 ] . Other methods use hidden states to estimate uncertainty [ 6 ] , assess truthfulness [ 2 ] , and detect harmful interactions [ 26 ] . This work’s V-lens translates hidden states into images as an additional pathway for analysis and model improvement.
blocks.zh:
之前的工作通过可视化学习到的特征[30]和识别执行特定行为的计算子图(电路)[31],使得神经计算更能解释. Sparse 自动编码器通过学习的特征组合重建激活,这些特征往往比单个神经元更容易解释[21]. 自然语言自动编码器通过文本描述来学习重建激活[13],而激活甲骨文则学习回答关于它们的问题[22].
隐藏状态镜头还旨在让中间计算为人类解释. 逻辑透镜通过模型的最终词预测层来读取早先的状态[29],这种方法也被用来分析视觉语言模型中的视觉符号[28]. 因为不同层的状态可以使用不同的表示,调谐镜头首先学习了线性映射,并且为每层进行抵消,以匹配模型的最终符号预测[4]. Jacobian的镜头,或J-lens,使用模型计算中的平均衍生物,在读取词汇表前将状态带向最后一层[18]. 其他方法使用隐蔽状态来估计不确定性[6],评估真实性[2],检测有害的相互作用[26]. 本作的V-lens将隐藏状态转化为图像,作为分析和模型改进的又一条途径.

blocks.en: Patchscopes and SelfIE use a model’s ability to generate text to explain its hidden states. They place a state into a new prompt to describe its content [ 15 , 7 ] , though decoding can favor the model’s own prior over the patched context [ 17 ] . The V-lens follows the Patchscopes construction with an image as the response, using the model’s own image generator. Activation patching also replaces states, but measures changes in the original task to test their causal role [ 27 ] . Lindsey injects concept representations into a model’s activations to test whether it notices and names them [ 24 ] . Work on multi-step reasoning asks whether a model identifies an unnamed concept in time to use it when answering [ 46 , 5 ] . Our questions use their two-step structure to visualize connecting objects from hidden states.
blocks.zh: 补丁镜和SelfIE使用模型生成文本的能力来解释其隐藏状态. 尽管解码可以偏向模型自身的前身, V-lens 遵循 Patchscopes 构造,以图像作为响应,使用模型自己的图像生成器. 激活补丁也取代了状态,但原始任务中的措施变化以测试其因果作用[27]. Lindsey在模型的激活中注入概念表示,以测试其是否注意到并命名它们[24]. 多步骤推理的工作询问一个模型是否及时识别出一个未命名的概念,以便在回答[46,5]时使用. 我们的问题用它们的两步结构来直观地将隐藏状态的物体连接起来.

blocks.en: Diffusion Lens is the closest prior method [ 40 ] . It decodes intermediate text-encoder representations through a separate diffusion model to trace the image prompt across layers. Diffusion Steering Lens visualizes vision transformer submodule outputs through diffusion [ 37 ] . The V-lens extends this idea to unified models that generate images and text without depending on an external text-encoder. It enables the visualization of a selected hidden state within questions, stories, or their own replies rather than mere image generation prompts. We center and rescale each coordinate of a chosen state before inserting it into a drawing prompt for the same model. This reads text computations through denoising or autoregressive image generation, complementing work that uses visual grounding or imagined pictures to aid language understanding and reasoning [ 38 , 47 , 25 , 48 , 36 ] .
blocks.zh: 扩散镜头是最接近的前置方法 [40]. 它通过单独的扩散模型解码中间文本编码器表示,以追踪跨层的图像提示. 扩散引导镜头通过扩散可视化视觉变压器子模块输出[37]. V-Lens将这一想法扩展至不依赖于外部文本编码器而生成图像和文本的统一模型. 它可以在问题、故事或他们自己的回答中,而不是仅仅在图像生成中,对选定的隐藏状态进行可视化。 在插入一个用于同一模型的绘图提示之前,我们将选定状态的每个坐标集中并重新调整比例。 此处读取文本通过去诺化或自旋式图像生成进行计算,补充使用视觉地面或想象图片来帮助语言理解和推理的作品[38,47,25,48,36].

blocks.en: Cho et al. [9] were among the first to explore unifying multimodal understanding and generation within one transformer framework. Subsequent models differ in parameter sharing and image generation objectives. The fully unified models Show-o2 and HunyuanImage-3.0 process text and image tokens through a shared transformer backbone [ 45 , 39 ] , while BAGEL and SenseNova-U1 use separate transformer blocks connected through attention [ 11 , 12 ] . These models generate images through diffusion or flow matching. Autoregressive alternatives such as Liquid and Janus-Pro instead predict discrete image tokens sequentially [ 44 , 8 ] . We show that the V-lens works for these different architectures and generation paradigms.
blocks.zh: Cho等人 (英语). [9] 是第一个在一个变压器框架内探索统一多式联运理解和生成的人之一。 随后的模型在参数共享和图像生成目标上有所不同. 全统一型号Show-o2和HunyuanImage-3.0工艺文本和图像符号通过共享变压器主干线[45,39],而BAGEL和SenseNova-U1则使用单独的变压器块通过注意力连接[11,12]. 这些模型通过扩散或流匹配生成图像. 例如液态和Janus-Pro 等自动回转的替代物,相反,可以按顺序预测离散的图像符号[44,8]. 我们显示,V-Lens为这些不同的建筑和世代范式工作.

blocks.en: 3 The V-lens
blocks.zh: 3个 V -Lens队

blocks.en: In their responses, modern language models may use concepts that they do not mention explicitly. To surface such concepts visually, the V-lens centers and rescales a text token’s intermediate hidden state before inserting it in a dedicated drawing request. We call the layer where we take the state the extraction layer ℓ \ell , and the layer where we place it the insertion layer R R . We fix R R per model and vary ℓ \ell to read a token at different depths. Figure 2 shows how a state reaches the image generator in three kinds of unified models. We then describe lens tuning , which trains hidden states on images via the V-lens to improve their visualizations, and examine how this affects the model’s text answers.

blocks.en: We calibrate the insertion layer to find the latest point where the model can still draw recognizable objects from hidden states. We take 12 common, visually distinct nouns from the concept lists of Udandarao et al. [41] , which CLIP [ 34 ] recognizes reliably [ 32 , 41 ] . Each word’s state from an ordinary sentence replaces thing in a photo of a thing at the same layer. We count how often CLIP ranks the intended word first among 100 concept names and choose the latest tested layer with the highest count. This gives R = 8 R=8 of 28 for BAGEL, R = 27 R=27 of 28 for Show-o2, R = 24 R=24 of 42 for SenseNova-U1, R = 9 R=9 of 32 for HunyuanImage-3.0, R = 6 R=6 of 28 for Liquid, and R = 8 R=8 of 30 for Janus-Pro, each recovering 12/12 words. All calibration and sampling settings are in Supp. A and I .

blocks.en: We chose the V-lens procedure among simpler and heavier ways of transporting a hidden state ( Tab. 1 ). The simplest variants copy the state unchanged or apply the model’s final normalization, including its gain, following Diffusion Lens [ 40 ] . The heavier variants fit an average Jacobian map from each layer to R R with gradients on 64 prompts, once with an added gain per layer. Writing the read word (e.g., animal ) into the request without its hidden state gives a context-free reference. Each lens variant is scored by how often it visualizes the concept that a question describes without explicitly naming it, with items and scoring detailed in Supp. A.3 . The coordinate scaling of Eq. 1 performs best on the validation set and remains best on the test set of fresh items, while requiring only simple layer statistics. Implementation details are in Supp. A .

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We first test whether a token’s visualization aligns with its context and how this alignment changes across layers. These tests use BAGEL [ 11 ] , Show-o2 [ 45 ] , SenseNova-U1 [ 12 ] , and HunyuanImage-3.0 [ 39 ] , with a fixed insertion layer per model, and the depth study also includes the autoregressive Liquid [ 44 ] . We then examine purely autoregressive models and apply lens tuning to improve hidden-state visualizations as well as answers about object states.
blocks.zh: 我们首先测试一个符号的可视化是否符合其上下文,以及这种对齐如何在各个层面上变化。 这些测试使用BAGEL [11],show-o2 [45],SenseNova-U1 [12],以及HunyuanImage-3.0 [39],每个模型有一个固定的插入层,深度研究还包括自旋液 [44]. 然后我们审查纯粹的自递性模型,并应用镜头调制来改进隐藏状态的可视化以及物体状态的答案.

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: We visualize each hidden state with three seeds. Three multimodal judges, Qwen3-VL [ 3 ] , Gemma-3 [ 14 ] , and LLaVA-OneVision-2 [ 1 ] , identify a picture’s main subject, such as the elephant from animal in . They are asked to ignore incidental background objects and written words. An image is successful when at least two judges identify its correct subject. A state has a correct visualization if at least two of three seeds generate a successful image. On a separate labeled calibration set, the model-based judgment is correct on 146/156 pictures, including 67/72 with background distractors. Three human raters each agreed with the judgment on at least 88% of 600 sampled pictures. Supp. B shows the questions, calibration, and rating breakdown.
blocks.zh: 我们用三种种子来想象每个隐藏状态。 三位多式联运裁判, Qune3-VL [3], Gemma-3 [14], 以及LLaVA-One Visions 2 [1], 他们被要求忽略偶然的背景对象和文字. 如果至少有两名法官确定一个正确的主题,一个形象是成功的。 如果3个种子中至少有2个生成成功的图像,则状态具有正确的可视性. 在单独的标注校准集上,基于模型的判断对146/156图片是正确的,包括带有背景分散器的67/72. 对600张抽样照片中至少88%的评分,每人有3人同意。 苏普。 B显示问题、校准和分级。

blocks.en: Two tests analyze a fixed token’s hidden state as its context in the text prompt changes. The first uses 30 pairs of factual questions describing unnamed objects, such as an animal with a long trunk and a tall plant with a thick trunk . The V-lens reads the last word of each description, here trunk , and the judges check whether its picture shows the described object, an elephant or a tree. The second test uses 20 homonyms (words with at least two meanings), each appearing twice in a sentence after clues to its meaning, such as a whiskered seal and a red wax seal . Reversing the order of their occurrence yields 40 sentences and 80 states to visualize. Supp. G explains how the items were built.
blocks.zh: 两种测试分析一个固定符的隐藏状态, 因为它在文本的上下文会提示更改 。 第一种使用30对事实问题来描述未命名的物体,例如树干长的动物和树干厚的高大的植物。 V -Lens读到每个描述的最后一个字,这里的树干, 评委检查它的图片是显示描述的对象, 大象还是树。 第二次测试使用20个同义词(至少含两个含义的词),每个词在提示其含义后在一句中两次出现,如胡须封和红蜡封. 推翻其发生顺序可产生40个句子和80个可视化状态. 苏普。 G解释了这些物品是如何建造的.

blocks.en: For descriptions, a pair is considered a success only when both texts’ hidden states succeed at the same layer. For words with two meanings, both occurrences must succeed in the sentence, and the word’s score averages the two orders. Sharing the final word across descriptions and reversing the order of the two meanings test whether pictures follow context, while controlling for a word’s usual associations and its position in the text. For these tests, the extraction layer is the insertion layer R R . To estimate what pictures that ignore context would score, we randomly swap the intended and alternative labels and rescore the entire test. The average over 10,000 such relabelings estimates chance performance, and the one-sided p p -value is the share of relabelings that score at least as high as the true labels. Supp. C also reports results at other extraction layers.
blocks.zh: 就描述而言,只有当两个文本的隐藏状态在同一层成功时,一对文本才被视为成功。 对于有两种含义的词,两种现象都必须在句子中成功,词的分数平均为两种顺序. 分享描述的词尾, 并颠倒两个含义的顺序, 对于这些测试,提取层是插入层R . 为了估计忽略上下文的哪些图片会得分,我们随机交换预定的和替代的标签,并重新记录整个测试. 平均超过10,000个这样的重新标签估计概率性能,单侧 p -值是重新标签中得分至少和真实标签一样高的份额. 苏普。 C还报告其他提取层的结果.

blocks.en: 4.2 The same word in different contexts
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 不同情况下的同一个词

blocks.en: Context can change the object visualized from the same word’s hidden state ( Tab. 2 ). Words with two meanings give the most consistent result, with 12.5/20 for BAGEL and 15/20 for each other model, all far above label-swap chance. These words already name the pictured objects, suggesting that choosing a meaning is easier to visualize than inferring an object. For unnamed objects, Show-o2 recovers both subjects in 8/30 description pairs and HunyuanImage-3.0 in 6/30. Figure 3 compares the V-lens reading of a word in context with the model’s default drawing of that word alone.
blocks.zh: 上下文可以从同一个词的隐藏状态(Tab. 2 )来改变可视化对象. 有两种含义的单词给出了最一致的结果,BAGEL的12.5/20和相互模型的15/20,都远高于标签-擦拭机会. 这些单词已经给图片对象命名,暗示选择一个含义比推断一个对象更容易被直观. 对于无名对象,Show-o2在8/30描述对中恢复了两个对象,在6/30中恢复了HunyuanImage-3.0. 图3比较了V-lens在上下文中读取的单词与模型默认仅该单词的绘图.

blocks.en: 4.3 Intermediate concepts across tokens and layers
blocks.zh: 4.3 跨标志和层次的中间概念

blocks.en: Having established that context can change a token’s V-lens visualization, we ask at what point in a model’s computation an intermediate concept becomes visualizable. To answer this, we create sixteen two-hop reasoning questions that describe a concept (first hop) and then ask for a short answer that depends on the described concept (second hop), like the teaser question On which continent does the biggest land animal live? ( ). We retain questions that the model answered correctly without naming the intermediate concept and read the description’s last word ( animal in the teaser) and every later token, including the instruction and chat-format tokens. As a reference, we visualize the concept’s token in a plain sentence, such as Yesterday I saw an elephant on my way home. Figure 4 shows the shares of questions with successful visualizations at the description’s last word, their best later token, and in the plain sentence.
blocks.zh: 在确定了这个背景后,我们问一个符号的V-lens可视化,在一个模型的计算中,一个中间概念在什么时候变得可视化。 为了回答这个问题,我们创建了十六个双跳推理问题,来描述一个概念(第一跳),然后要求一个依赖于所描述概念(第二跳)的简短答案,就像逗人的问题 最大的陆地动物生活在哪个大陆上? ( ) 我们保留了模型正确回答的问题,而没有给中间概念命名,并读取了描述的最后一个词(动物在笑语中)和后来的每个符号,包括指示和聊天格式的符号。 例如昨天我在回家的路上看到一头大象。 图4显示在描述的最后一个字、其最优的后缀和句子中,问题与可视化成功的比例。

The dotted lines mark each model’s insertion layer.

blocks.en:
At the description’s last word, the V-lens recovers the concept in at least two thirds of questions at R R in all five models. Later recovery is much weaker in BAGEL and HunyuanImage-3.0, while Show-o2, SenseNova-U1, and Liquid often make the object visualizable at chat-format tokens. These tokens open the answer turn in Show-o2 and close the empty thinking block in SenseNova-U1, recovering the concept more often than any single question word, consistent with low-content positions serving as computation sites [ 10 ] . Even here, recovery depends on depth. Just before the answer, Show-o2 falls from 11/15 at layer 24 to 0/15 at layer 27, a prespecified difference of 0.73 with a 95% interval of [ 0.53 , 0.93 ] [0.53,0.93] . The concept’s token in a plain sentence remains readable in all 15 cases at both layers. Among the other models, only Liquid shows the concept immediately before the answer, in up to 4/13.
Supp. D breaks these curves down by token. Text readouts of the same hidden states (logit lens, tuned lens, J-lens) rank the object among their ten most likely words at the description’s last word in at most 4 questions per model at R R (Supp. D.1 ).
blocks.zh:
在描述的最后一个词中,V-lens在所有五个模型中RR至少三分之二的问题中恢复了这一概念. 后来的恢复在BAGEL和HunyuanImage-3.0中要弱得多,而Show-o2,SenseNova-U1和Liquid则经常使对象在聊天格式的符号上可视化. 这些令牌打开了Show-o2中的答案,关闭了SenseNova-U1中的空思维块,比任何单个问题词都更经常地恢复概念,与作为计算站点的低内容位置一致 [10]. 即使在这里,恢复也取决于深度. 就在答案之前,Show-o2从第24层的11/15下降到第27层的0/15,预示的差值为0.73,间隔为95% [0.53,0.93]. 这一概念在简单句子中的象征意义在两个层次的所有15个案例中都仍然可以读取。 在其他模型中,只有Liquid在回答前立即显示这个概念,最多为4/13.
Supp. D以符号打破这些曲线 。 同一隐藏状态(logit 透镜、调制透镜、J-lens)的文本读出,在R R 的每个模型中,在描述的最后一个词中,最多4个问题(Supp. D.1),将对象排在十个最可能的词中。

blocks.en: 4.4 Picturing a thought while copying a sentence
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 模仿句子时想象一个想法

blocks.en:
Following the setup of earlier work [ 23 , 24 ] , we ask the two fully unified models Show-o2 and HunyuanImage-3.0 to copy a sentence verbatim while thinking about an unrelated object. We then read the V-lens only at the tokens of the copied sentence in the response. Responses only count when their case-insensitive Ratcliff–Obershelp similarity [ 35 ] to the original target sentence is at least 0.85.
In Show-o2, the word the in the copy shows a bicycle at layer 25 in all three seeds when the model is asked to think about a bicycle, and in no seed when it is asked to think about a rose or receives no such instruction ( Fig. 5 shows one seed). In HunyuanImage-3.0, the final period token of the copy reveals a bread roll at layer 25. These two tokens carry little content of their own, like the chat-format tokens in Sec. 4.3 .

在Show-o2中,副本中的单词在所有三个种子中都显示一个第25层的自行车,当要求模型思考自行车时,没有要求它思考玫瑰或没有得到这样的指示时,没有种子(图5显示一个种子). 在HunyuanImage-3.0中,该副本的末期符号揭示了25层的面包卷. 这两件信物本身内容很少,如第4.3节中的聊天格式信物.

blocks.en: 4.5 Autoregressive image generators
blocks.zh: 4.5 自动后退图像生成器

blocks.en: The V-lens also reads hidden states in Liquid [ 44 ] and Janus-Pro [ 8 ] , two unified models whose image generators produce discrete image tokens one after another. We use the same coordinate scaling and drawing request. In Fig. 6 , the state of bear shows a polar bear when the question asks where the white bear lives, and that of trunk shows the elephant even though it is not mentioned explicitly in the question. On the two-meaning test of Tab. 2 , both meanings are recovered for 12/20 words in Liquid and 11.5/20 in Janus-Pro, averaging the two sentence orders. Again, both substantially exceed the chance performance ( p = 0.0002 p=0.0002 and p = 0.0001 p=0.0001 ). Figure 4 counts 13 questions for Liquid, while Janus-Pro answers only 6/16 correctly (Supp. I ).

blocks.en: 4.6 Supervision through the lens
blocks.zh: 4.6 通过镜头进行监督

blocks.en: We test whether the V-lens can visualize the referent of the pronoun it in 20 pairs of texts that use a verb to specify which one of two named objects is referred to. For example, it is the sandwich in A candle and a sandwich were on the table. He ate it. and the candle when the text ends with He lit it. At the insertion layer, the untrained models reveal both referents in 0/20 pairs for BAGEL, 4/20 for SenseNova-U1, and 0/20 for HunyuanImage-3.0, while Show-o2 correctly visualizes 16/20 ( Tab. S7 ). We therefore apply lens tuning ( Sec. 3 ) to the first three models.
blocks.zh: 我们测试V-lens能否在20对文本中将其代词的参考词直观化,这些文本使用动词来指定两个命名对象中的哪一个被提及. 例如,是蜡烛里的三明治,桌上有三明治。 他吃过了 和以火烧灼的蜡烛。 在插入层中,未经过训练的模型在BAGEL的0/20对,SenseNova-U1的4/20和HunyuanImage-3.0的0/20中分别揭示出两个参考物,而Show-o2则正确可视化了16/20(Tab. S7). 因此,我们对前三种型号采用了镜头调音(第3节)。

Each column pair shows the V-lens pictures of the boxed it after one kind of training, with correct pictures framed. Only lens tuning makes both pictures correct in all three models. blocks.zh: 图7: Lens调制教一个代词的隐藏状态来显示它所指的对象. 更改搁置句中的动词选择其两个对象中的一个. 每个栏目对齐显示在经过一种训练后被盒装的V-Lens照片,并有正确的图片框框. 只有镜头调音使得这三种模型中的两种图片都正确. 表3给出了所有测试对子和种子的分数.

blocks.en:
Each training text also names two things and uses a verb to identify one of them. We use 48 nouns for training and 18 each for development and testing. Each model is trained on the texts in which it correctly names the referent. We evaluate on three test sets of 80 texts each, all unseen during training. The judges pick one of four options for each picture, namely the specified referent, the other named object, both, or neither. A pair succeeds only when both texts show their specified referent.
We train rank-8 low-rank adapters (LoRA) in the attention and feed-forward weights [ 20 ] , in layers 0 to 7 for BAGEL, 0 to 23 for SenseNova-U1, and 0 to 8 for HunyuanImage-3.0. As image targets, we use pictures the frozen model draws when prompted with the referent. Details are in Supp. F and G .
blocks.zh:
每个训练文本还命名了两个东西,并使用动词来识别其中之一. 我们使用48个名词进行培训,18个名词用于发展和测试。 每个模型都接受有关文本的培训,其中正确命名了裁判员。 我们评估三套测试,每套80个文本,都是在训练期间不见的。 评委为每张图片选择四个选项中的一个,即指定的裁判,另一个命名对象,两者皆有,或无. 一对只有在两种文本都显示其指定的引用时才成功.
我们训练8级低档适配器(LORA)在注意和饲料前进重量[20],BAGEL分0至7级,SenseNova-U1分0至23级,Hunyuanimage-3.0. 作为图像目标,我们使用被冷冻的模型在与指针的刺激下绘制的照片. 详情见补编F和G。

blocks.en: We compare lens tuning with text supervision of the referent’s name, word state supervision that aligns centered pronoun and referent hidden states by cosine similarity, and ordinary drawing supervision using the same pictures and loss through the usual drawing route with A photo of it. appended to the text. The comparisons share texts, adapter locations, and update budgets. In Tab. 3 , lens success requires both pronoun states of a pair to show their referents through the V-lens in two of three seeds. We evaluate lens success on unseen texts to test whether lens tuning generalizes and makes states more visually interpretable. The column Verbs uses unseen verbs, Nouns tests generalization on unseen nouns, and Phrases uses sentence forms that were not encountered during training, such as Our neighbour kept a goat and a purse. One day he fed it.
blocks.zh: 我们比较镜头调制与裁判名称的文字监督, 将中间的代词和参考的隐藏状态通过余弦的相似度对齐的单词状态监督, 案文附后。 比较共用文本、适配器位置和更新预算。 在Tab. 3中,镜头成功需要双双的代名词状态,才能在三个种子中的两个中通过V-lens来显示他们的参照. 我们评价镜片在隐形文本上的成功,以测试镜片是否调整一般,使状态更具有视觉解释性. 专栏Verbs使用隐形动词,名词测试在隐形名词上的概括化,词组使用在训练中没有遇到的句子表,比如我们的邻居保存一只山羊和一个钱包. 一日供养.

blocks.en: Lens tuning succeeds on 0.92–0.99 of pairs with unseen nouns or sentence forms, while the specification of the referent through verbs remains harder with only 0.70–0.84 correctly visualized pronoun pairs ( Tab. 3 ). Picture supervision through the ordinary drawing request also helps visualize the hidden state, most clearly in SenseNova-U1, but falls well short of lens tuning. Word state supervision also makes referents visualizable without pictures and exceeds lens tuning on unseen phrases in SenseNova-U1 and on unseen nouns and phrases in HunyuanImage-3.0, but it trails lens tuning on unseen verbs in all three models and on nouns in BAGEL and SenseNova-U1. Finally, text supervision leaves lens success near its untrained level. Lens tuning shows no significant loss in general image generation on GenEval [ 16 ] or in text knowledge on MMLU-Pro [ 43 ] (Supp. F.3 ). Making a state visualizable gives us a way to supervise a unified model’s reasoning through pictures. This motivates an investigation into whether visual supervision through the V-lens can also affect a model’s verbal answers.
blocks.zh: Lens调音成功在0.92–0.99对带有看不见的名词或句子形式的配对上,而通过动词对引用者的规格仍然比较困难,只有0.70–0.84对正确可视化的代词配对(Tab. 3). 通过普通的绘图请求进行图片监督也帮助可视化隐藏状态,最明显的是在SenseNova-U1中,但远远没有镜头调试. 单词状态监督也使得可视化的参考词没有图片,并且超过了SenseNova-U1和HunyuanImage-3.0中未见的名词和词组的镜头调值,但它会跟踪所有三种模型中未见的动词和BAGEL和SenseNova-U1中名词的镜头调值. 最后,文字监督使得镜头成功率接近未经训练的水平. 在GenEval[16]或MMLU-Pro[43]的文本知识(Supp.F.3)上,Lens调制显示一般图像生成没有重大损失。 让状态具有可视性可以让我们通过图片监督统一模型的推理。 这促使人们调查通过V-lens进行视觉监督是否也会影响模型的口头回答.

blocks.en: 4.7 Training the pictured state changes the answer
blocks.zh: 4.7 培训情况改变了答案

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Training the pictured state changes the answer in Show-o2 and HunyuanImage-3.0. The V-lens visualizes the subject of supervised stories before and after lens tuning. Below each picture is the model’s text answer with its corresponding probability.
blocks.zh: 图8:培训的状态改变了Show-o2和HunyuanImage-3.0. V-Lens可视化镜头调谐前后的受监督故事主题. 每个图片下面是模型的文本答案及其相应的概率.

blocks.en: We next ask whether lens tuning, which uses purely visual supervision, can also change a model’s textual response behavior. We test the fully unified Show-o2 and HunyuanImage-3.0 on 40 paired scenarios (80 stories). For example, A slice of white bread was put in the toaster for three minutes. is paired with A slice of white bread was left in its bag for three minutes. We ask Is the slice of bread now white or brown? We supervise the second bread , in the question, through the V-lens with the loss of Eq. 2 , again using the model’s own pictures of brown toast for the toaster story and white bread for the bag story. Because models favor one option position, the experiment also asks each question with the options reversed, as in Is the slice of bread now brown or white? A story counts as correct only when the one-word replies name the right option in both orders ( Tab. 4 ), and Fig. 8 reports a two-option probability from the margin averaged over both orders.
blocks.zh: 接下来我们问镜头调音,使用纯粹的视觉监督,是否能够改变模型的文字反应行为. 我们测试完全统一的Show-o2和HunyuanImage-3. 例如,一片白面包被放进烤面包机里长达3分钟. 与一块白面包配对 留在包里3分钟 我们问面包是白的还是棕的? 我们通过V -lens 来监督第二块面包, 因为模型偏爱一个选项位置,实验也用选项倒置来问每个问题,比如面包片现在是棕色还是白色? 一个故事只有在一个词的回答在两个顺序(Tab. 4)中都指定了正确的选项时才算正确,图8则报告从两个顺序的平均值中得出两个选项的概率.

blocks.en: Training the model with pictures that show the correct state of the object raises the share of stories that Show-o2 answers correctly from 36.3% to 49.6%, while its corresponding V-lens visualizations show the right state in 73.3% instead of 52.5% ( Tab. 4 ). Supervision with pictures that show the incorrect state leaves the answers near the untrained level and reduces the correct-picture rate to 27.1%. In HunyuanImage-3.0, correct answers rise from 40.0% to 50.8%, but training on the incorrect state also raises them to 47.5%. Figure 8 shows the pictured state and the preferred answer changing together, as when a snowman in the spring sun disappears or white bread put in the toaster turns brown.
blocks.zh: 用显示对象正确状态的照片对模型进行培训,将Show-o2正确回答的故事比例从36.3%提高到49.6%,而其对应的V-lens可视化显示为73.3%而非52.5%的正确状态(Tab. 4). 用显示不正确状态的图片进行监管会让答案接近未训练的级别,并将正确图片率降低到27.1%. 在HunyuanImage-3.0中,正确答案从40.0 %上升到50.8%,但关于不正确状态的培训也将其提高到47.5%。 图8显示图片状态和首选答案一起变化,如春日中的雪人消失或将白面包放入烤面包箱时变为棕色.

blocks.en: To further test the impact of lens tuning on the hidden states, we use a second set of 56 stories and perform isolated swaps of hidden states. Specifically, in each story we replace the subject token’s state at every layer of the original Show-o2 with the corresponding state from the picture-trained counterpart. We then read the same question and check whether the original model can now answer it correctly using the subject’s swapped hidden state. Indeed, correct answers rise from 41/56 to 47–49/56, transferring 21–39% of the margin gain. The trained subject states thus carry part of the answer change, though this transfer does not isolate the information shown in their pictures. Settings and per-seed results are listed in Supp. F .
blocks.zh: 为了进一步测试镜头调音对隐藏状态的影响,我们使用第二套56个故事,并进行对隐藏状态的孤立互换. 具体地说,在每个故事中,我们用图片训练的对应方的对应状态来代替主题符号在原始show-o2的每层状态. 然后,我们读了同样的问题,并检查原始模型现在是否可以使用主体互换的隐藏状态正确回答它. 事实上,正确的答案从41/56上升到47/49/56,转移了21-39%的利润。 因此,受培训的科目包含部分答案变化,尽管这种传输不会隔离其图片中显示的信息。 设置和每个种子的结果列于Supp.F。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
The V-lens enables the visualization of intermediate hidden states in four unified models with diffusion-based image generators and two purely autoregressive models. Lens tuning strengthens state-referent associations, making pronoun referents visualizable in BAGEL, SenseNova-U1, and HunyuanImage-3.0, and correcting text answers on supervised stories in Show-o2 and HunyuanImage-3.0. Transferring the trained subject word’s states to the original Show-o2 carries part of the answer correction, which connects the states we visualize to the answers the model writes.
What we can visualize depends on the token, layer, and drawing request. Importantly, a failure to visualize a concept does not establish that the hidden state lacks information about it. The answer corrections were measured on supervised stories, and the state transfers test whole hidden states without isolating the information visible in their pictures. The lens thus connects the inspection of intermediate hidden states with training through the model’s own generator.
blocks.zh:
V-lens使得中间隐藏状态的可视化在四个统一的模型中,具有以扩散为基础的图像生成器和两个纯粹自递性模型. 伦斯调制加强了州际反响协会,使代名词参考词在BAGEL,SenseNova-U1和HunyuanImage-3.0中可视化,并在Show-o2和HunyuanImage-3.0. 将训练过的主题词的状态转移至原始的 Show-o2 包含部分的答案校正,它将我们可视化的状态与模型写出的答案联系起来.
我们可以想象的东西 取决于 符号,层,和绘图请求。 重要的是,无法将一个概念直观化并不能证明隐藏的国家缺乏有关它的信息. 答案的校正被测量在被监督的故事上,国家转移测试整个隐藏状态而不隔离其图片中可见的信息. 因此,透镜通过模型本身的发电机将检查中间隐藏状态与培训联系起来。

blocks.en: A.1 Hidden states and drawing requests
blocks.zh: A.1 隐藏状态和绘图请求

blocks.en: We take the hidden state entering a transformer block, before its normalization and attention, with layers numbered from zero. The extraction layer ℓ \ell is where we take the state, and the insertion layer R R is where we place it in the drawing request. For a word split into several tokens, we take its last token. The model processes the source text separately, without drawing. The chosen hidden state then replaces the state of one token in a separate drawing request, and the layers after the insertion point recompute the request from that replacement. The single-state request is a photo of a thing for BAGEL, Show-o2, and HunyuanImage-3.0 and the bare word thing for SenseNova-U1. The two-state requests are a photo of a plain thing and plain thing , where the modifier state replaces plain and the object or pronoun state replaces thing . The alternative two-state template is a photo of a thing that is plain . We use each model’s drawing settings ( Tab. S1 ), message markers, and system text. BAGEL and SenseNova-U1 read the request into keys and values used by separate generation weights. Show-o2 processes the text again at every denoising step, so the replacement is repeated in the conditional branch only.

blocks.en: B.1 The main-subject question

blocks.en: The judges are Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct, Gemma-3-27B-it, and LLaVA-OneVision-2-8B-Instruct. Here we describe the default main-subject question with four choices. The lens-variant comparison uses the six choices of Sec. A.3 , and the two-state and general capability studies use the questions of Secs. E.1 and F.3 . A judge sees only the picture and its answer choices, never the source sentence, layer, model, or training condition. The question is Which of these is depicted as a main subject of the picture? Ignore incidental background objects and written words. The choices are the intended object, the alternative object, both, as main subjects , and neither, as a main subject , with the first two shuffled by picture identifier, followed by Answer with the letter only. We select the letter with the highest model probability. A picture succeeds when at least two judges choose the intended object alone. Unless a study specifies otherwise, a hidden state succeeds when two of its three drawing seeds succeed. A pair succeeds only when both texts succeed at the same layer. For words with two meanings, both occurrences must succeed within one sentence. Averaging the two sentence orders gives a word score of zero, one half, or one.

blocks.en: B.2 Chance levels and intervals

blocks.en: Context scores are compared with 10,000 label swaps within pairs, or within words with both meanings exchanged together. Each swap recomputes the paired score, the chance estimate is the mean swapped score, and the one-sided p p -value is ( 1 + n ≥ ) / ( 1 + 10,000 ) (1+n_{\geq})/(1+10{,}000) . Context intervals use 2,000 bootstrap samples of pairs or words. The depth and two-state comparisons use paired bootstrap samples of questions or object pairs. Training intervals use 10,000 bootstrap samples of whole noun pairs, keeping both noun orders together and averaging the seeds within each text pair. The training seeds therefore do not count as independent test items in these intervals.
blocks.zh: 上下文的分数在对数内与一万个标签互换比较,或者在有两种含义并用的文字内进行交换. 每个互换重算成对的分数,概率估计为平均互换的分数,单侧p-值为(1+n ≥) /(1+n_{\geq})/(1+10{,}000). 上下文间隔使用2,000个对数或单词的靴状样本. 深度和双态比较使用对偶的靴子样本来检测问题或对象对. 训练间隔使用1万个全名词对的靴子样本,使名词顺序一致,并平均各文本对中的种子. 因此,培训种子在间隔期间不计为独立的试验品。

blocks.en: We first examine three fixed positions for the prespecified depth comparison. The description position is the last token of the description’s last word. The question-end position is the question’s last token, its question mark. For the position before the answer, the model answers the question followed by Answer with one word. We locate the first accepted answer in the greedy reply and read the token right before it. In BAGEL this is the start-of-turn marker, in Show-o2 the line break after the assistant marker, in SenseNova-U1 the blank line after its empty thinking block, and in HunyuanImage-3.0 a space, except for one question whose reply begins with bold markup. A question counts when its answer is accepted and the model has not named the object before answering, so denominators differ slightly by model and condition. The prespecified comparison tests Show-o2 before the answer at layer 24 against layer 27 ( Tab. S10 ), requiring recovery in at least half the questions at layer 24 and a paired 95% interval above zero. Figure S1 shows all curves, and Tab. S10 gives Show-o2’s late-layer counts.

blocks.en: For the best-later-token curves in Fig. 4 , we also read every token after the description’s last word through the first answer token. This includes the remaining question words, punctuation, the instruction Answer with one word. , and the model’s chat-format tokens. At each layer, a question counts when at least one of these hidden states shows the described object. Table S11 separates the successful states by token type. blocks.en: We apply three text readouts to the hidden states from the context tests at R R and the depth study. The logit lens applies the model’s final normalization and word prediction layer to the state [ 29 ] . The tuned lens first adds a learned affine map per layer [ 4 ] , and the text J-lens first carries the state to the last layer with an average Jacobian [ 18 ] . Both are fitted on 200 plain-text passages, and HunyuanImage-3.0 has no J-lens. A reading succeeds when the highest-ranked first token across all spellings of the object’s name is among the ten most likely tokens. Pairs, words with two meanings, and questions are counted as for the pictures. One description pair is left out because its two names start with the same token. Table S12 compares the counts with the V-lens . At the insertion layer, the text readouts rarely place the object’s name among their ten most likely tokens. At the best later token, usually a chat-format token, the logit and J-lenses find it in most SenseNova-U1 questions, where the pictures also show it. The logit lens does so in HunyuanImage-3.0, where the pictures do not.

blocks.en: The two-state experiments use unchanged copies to visualize an object’s color or pattern from two hidden states ( Fig. S2 ). Both states enter R R without the centering and rescaling of Eq. 1 . Eight development pairs and eight held-out pairs with new objects and sentence forms assign two colors or patterns to each object. After The car was painted bright red. Later I looked at it. , we copy the states of red and it unchanged into separate slots at the insertion layer. The modifier and noun states from an explicit drawing request check that both can be recovered together. We compare this with the pronoun alone, the pronoun in both slots, and states exchanged between texts with another color, pattern, or object.

blocks.en: All models recover the modifier and object from the explicit drawing requests, except for one HunyuanImage-3.0 development pair. With both required in the picture, the modifier and pronoun from contextual texts succeed in 5/8 held-out pairs for Show-o2, 3/7 for HunyuanImage-3.0, 1/7 for SenseNova-U1, and 0/7 for BAGEL. Neither the pronoun alone nor the duplicated pronoun succeeds, and the noun alone almost never shows a value. In HunyuanImage-3.0 the noun alone already shows the colored car and cup, one pair per split. In Show-o2 the gain over the pronoun alone is 0.63, with a 95% interval of [ 0.25 , 0.88 ] [0.25,0.88] . SenseNova-U1 often shows the intended color on a different object. Exchanging the modifier changes the color with the object present in 3/8 held-out Show-o2 pairs. Exchanging the pronoun changes the object in 13/16 held-out value cases, using the main-subject question with the two objects as choices. These comparisons show that the modifier and pronoun states make separate contributions to Show-o2’s pictures. Together, the two states can show a colored object even though neither expresses both properties.
blocks.zh: 所有模型都从明确的绘图请求中回收了修饰剂和对象,除了一个HunyuanImage-3.0开发对. 由于图片中要求两者,背景文本的修饰和代词在Show-o2、HunyuanImage-3.0、SenseNova-U1和BAGEL0/7的5/8挂断对中成功。 单词的代词和重复的代词都没有成功,单词几乎从未显示一个值. 在HunyuanImage-3.0中,单词已经显示彩色车和杯子,每分一对. 在Show-o2中,仅代词的增益为0.63,95%的间隔为[0.25,0.88] [0.25,0.88]. SenseNova - U1经常在不同的对象上显示预定的颜色. 交换修饰符会用 3/8 hold-out Show-o2 对中的对象来改变颜色 。 交换代词会改变13/16挂载值中的对象,使用两个对象的主要主体问题作为选择. 这些比较表明,修饰和代名词状态对Show-o2的图片分别贡献. 两个状态加在一起,可以显示一个有色物体,尽管两者都不表示两个属性.

blocks.en: E.1 Conditions and scoring
blocks.zh: E.1 条件和评分

blocks.en: We did not inspect the held-out pairs during development. Partner objects share their modifier values, so object states can be exchanged between them. The same three judges answer two questions about each picture. The attribute question is What colour is the car in this picture? , or the pattern equivalent with stripes and spots (polka dots) , with the choices being the two values, both or unclear , something else , and there is no car . The presence question is Is there a car in this picture? with yes and no. A picture is correct when two of three judges give the intended value and two of three say the object is there. A state succeeds in at least two of three seeds, and a pair succeeds for both values. We include a pair when both explicit requests pass this test, which leaves 14 pairs for BAGEL (7 development, 7 held-out), 14 for Show-o2 (6 and 8), and 15 each for SenseNova-U1 and HunyuanImage-3.0 (8 and 7). Table S13 reports every condition scored by both values, including alternative drawing templates and two states averaged into one slot. The pronoun exchange is scored by the main-subject question instead and is reported in the text. All four models use the same items, seeds, judges, and rules.
blocks.zh: 我们在开发期间没有检查被搁置的对子。 伙伴对象共享其修饰值,因此对象状态可以在它们之间交换. 同三名法官回答了关于每张照片的两个问题。 属性问题是,这张照片中的车是什么颜色? ,或图案等同带条纹和斑点(波尔卡点),选择是两个值,两者兼有或不明确,别的东西,没有汽车。 这张照片里有辆车吗? 与是与否. 当三位评委中的两位给出了预期值,而三位评委中的两位评委则表示该标的物存在时,图片是正确的. 一个状态在三个种子中至少两个成功,两个值的一对成功. 在两个明确要求都通过这项测试时,我们包括一对,为BAGEL留下14对(7个开发,7个搁置),为Show-o2(6个和8个),为SenseNova-U1和Hunyuanimage-3.0各留下15对(8个和7个)。 表S13报告按两个值评分的每个条件,包括备选绘图模板和平均分为一个槽的两个状态. 代名词交换则由主体问题评分,并在文字中报告. 所有四个型号都使用相同的物品,种子,评委,以及规则.

Appendix F Training through the lens
blocks.zh: 附录F 通过镜头进行的培训

blocks.en: F.1 Data and training
blocks.zh: F.1 数据和培训

blocks.en: We train adapters in BAGEL, SenseNova-U1, and HunyuanImage-3.0. During lens tuning, adapters act only on the source text, while the drawing request and generator remain frozen. The texts use 84 noun labels in six categories, each category with eight training, three development, and three held-out labels ( Tab. S23 ). Only categories whose selecting verbs cannot apply to the other object are paired. Each pair appears in both noun orders, with each noun selected in turn. For BAGEL and SenseNova-U1, the training pool has 60 pairs in four sentence forms, 960 texts in all. For each model, we retain the texts whose referent it names correctly, 696 for BAGEL and 798 for SenseNova-U1. Three test sets of 20 noun pairs, named as in Tab. 3 , use new pairs of training nouns with a held-out selecting verb per category ( Verbs ), held-out noun labels ( Nouns ), and new pairs of training nouns in two held-out sentence forms ( Phrases ). Each test set has 80 texts, forming 40 pairs with the same noun order and a different selected referent. Both texts must give the intended referent. For development, we use 20 additional pairs whose noun labels do not occur in training or testing.
blocks.zh: 我们在BAGEL,SenseNova-U1和Hunyuanimage-3.0. 在镜头调谐时,适配器只作用于源文本,而绘图请求和生成器则保持冻结. 文本使用84个名词标签,分为6个类别,每个类别有8个训练,3个开发,以及3个挂号标签(Tab. S23. ). 只有选择动词不能适用于其他对象的类别才成对。 每个对子在两种名词顺序中出现,每个名词依次选择. 对于BAGEL和SenseNova-U1,训练池有60对4句形式,共有960个文本. 对于每种型号,我们保留其正确名称的文本,BAGEL696和SenseNova-U1798。 三套20个名词对,以Tab命名. 3,使用新对的训练名词,并用一个按类别(Verbs)选择动词,被搁置的名词标签(Nouns),以及两个被搁置的句子形式(phrases )的新对训练名词. 每个测试集有80个文本,组成40对,名词顺序相同,并有不同的选取参考. 这两个文本必须给出预期的参考。 为了发展,我们使用了另外20对在训练或测试中不出现名词标签的配对.

blocks.en: For BAGEL and SenseNova-U1, LoRA adapters of rank 8 and scaling 16 modify the query, key, value, attention-output, gate, up, and down projections of the understanding weights in layers 0 to 7 and 0 to 23, respectively. These models use AdamW with learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} and no weight decay for 600 updates of 16 texts sampled with replacement. We evaluate the final checkpoint with no selection on test data. For each training noun, we keep up to four target pictures from the frozen model’s own drawings with seeds 0 to 5 when at least two judges recognize the noun. For each loss evaluation, we sample a target, a noise level uniformly on [ 0.4 , 1 ] [0.4,1] , and fresh Gaussian noise, and use the conditional denoising loss without guidance on VAE latents for BAGEL and pixels for SenseNova-U1. Gradients pass through the frozen generator to the text adapters. During lens tuning the adapters act only on the source text, and the drawing request uses unchanged weights.
blocks.zh: 对于BAGEL和SenseNova-U1,8级和16级的LORA适配器分别修改了0至7层和0至23层的理解权重的查询,键,值,注意力输出,闸门,上下预测. 这些模型使用 AdamW 的学习率为 10 - 4 10 - 4 = 4 = , 并且没有对600 个更新的 16 个文本进行重衰变, 以 替换 。 我们评估最后检查站,没有测试数据。 每一个训练名词,我们保存最多四张来自冷冻模型自己绘画的目标图片,其中种子为0-5,届时至少有两名评委认出名词. 对于每次损失评价,我们取样一个目标,一个在[0.4, 1] [0.4, 1] 上一致的噪声水平,以及新的高斯噪声,并在没有BAGEL和SenseNova-U1像素的VAE潜象指导的情况下使用有条件的去诺损失. 梯度通过冷冻生成器到文本适配器. 在镜头调试期间,适配器只作用于源文本,绘图请求使用不变的权重.

blocks.en: For HunyuanImage-3.0, we place adapters in layers 0 to 8 before insertion layer 9 and train them for 200 updates of 16 texts. The four training arms use the same test items, measures, scorer, and three training seeds as the other models. Lens tuning succeeds on 0.71 of the pairs in Verbs , 0.94 in Nouns , and 0.92 in Phrases . Word state supervision gives 0.65, 0.97, and 0.99. Its overall gain over text supervision is 0.79 with a 95% interval of [ 0.73 , 0.84 ] [0.73,0.84] . Ordinary drawing supervision raises pair-level drawing success from 0.03 to 0.69. Answers on the untrained question forms average 0.71 before training, 0.79 after text supervision, 0.75 after lens tuning, and 0.79 after ordinary drawing.
blocks.zh: 对于HunyuanImage-3.0,我们在插入第9层之前将适配器放入0至8层,并训练它们进行16个文本的200个更新. 四种训练武器与其他型号一样,使用相同的试验品,措施,计分器,以及三种训练种子. 镜头调音在Verbs的0.71对,名词的0.94对和词的0.92对上成功. 文字状态监督给予0.65,0.97和0.99. 它在文本监督上的总体收益为0.79,间隔95%为[0.73,0.84] [0.73,0.84]. 普通的绘画监督将双层绘画成功率从0.03提高到0.69. 未受过训练的问题的答案在训练前平均为0.71,文字监督后为0.79,镜头调音后为0.75,普通绘画后为0.79.

blocks.en: F.2 Kinds of training and evaluation
blocks.zh: F.2 联合国 培训和评价类型

blocks.en: Text supervision predicts The { referent } . after a question asking what it refers to. Lens tuning applies the denoising loss through the pronoun’s hidden state. Ordinary drawing supervision uses the same targets and noise schedule but conditions on the full text followed by A photo of it. , with adapters active throughout. We use two controls. Word state supervision minimizes one minus the cosine between the centered states of the pronoun and the referent word over four neutral sentences, while the wrong-picture control applies lens tuning with pictures of a fixed wrong noun from another category.
blocks.zh: 文本监管预测 {参考}。 问到它指的是什么。 Lens调制通过代词的隐藏状态应用去名损失. 普通的绘图监督使用相同的目标和噪音时间表,但在全文上附加条件,然后是照片。 我们用两个控制器 单词状态监督将代词中心状态与引用词之间的余弦最小化为1减去4个中性句子,而错误的图片控制则应用镜头调和,从另一个类别中固定错误名词的图片.

blocks.en: Lens evaluation visualizes each pronoun state with three seeds. A pair of texts succeeds when each referent is shown in two of its three seeds. Ordinary drawing uses the full text followed by A photo of it. , and a text must succeed in both seeds. Text evaluation asks the trained naming question, an untrained choice between the two nouns, and two yes or no questions about the categories of the referent and the alternative. The untrained score averages the latter three. The preservation tests cover texts that the untrained lens already visualizes correctly and 40 general questions. The prespecified transfer rule requires a gain of at least 0.15 over no training on the three test sets, an interval above zero, and an improvement on held-out noun labels. Tables S14 , S15 , S16 , S18 and S18 report all BAGEL and SenseNova-U1 scores by training type, test set, and seed.
blocks.zh: 月球评价可视化每个代名词状态有3个种子. 当每个引用者在其三个种子中的两个种子中显示时,一对文本成功. 普通绘图使用后面的全文,然后是照片.,文本必须在两种种子中都成功。 文字评价提出训练有素的命名问题,两个名词之间未经过训练的选择,两个是或没有关于裁判的类别和替代的问题. 未经过训练的分数平均为后三分. 保存测试涵盖了未经训练的镜头已经正确视觉的文本和40个一般问题. 预设的转录规则要求至少获得0.15的增益,而不是在三套测试中进行训练,间隔时间高于0,并改进被扣的名词标签. 表S14,S15,S16,S18和S18按训练类型,测试集和种子报告所有BAGEL和SenseNova-U1的分数.

blocks.en: The texts test pronoun reference between two objects of different categories, and the judges choose the specified referent, the other named object, both, or neither. Held-out noun labels never occur among the training labels, although familiar appearances can still occur in generated targets. The wrong-picture control is scored for the intended referent. Its zero shows that, among the arms trained with pictures, the referent becomes readable from the pronoun’s hidden state only when the pictures depict it.
blocks.zh: 文本测试不同类别两个对象之间的代名词引用,评委们选择指定的代名词,另一个命名对象,两者兼有,或均无. 在训练标签中从未出现挂掉的名词标签,尽管在生成的目标中仍然会出现熟悉的外表. 错误的图片控制被评为意向参考者. 它的零显示,在用图片训练的臂膀中,只有在图片描绘时才能从代词的隐藏状态读取指针.

blocks.en: F.3 General capabilities after training
blocks.zh: F.3 培训后的一般能力

blocks.en: For each model, we compare training seed 0 of text supervision, ordinary drawing supervision, and lens tuning with the untrained model, keeping adapters active throughout evaluation, including drawing. For image generation, we randomly select 20 prompts from each of GenEval’s six categories [ 16 ] before evaluating any checkpoint and draw one picture per prompt using each model’s ordinary text-to-image path with its default settings and drawing seed 0. Our three judges replace GenEval’s object detector and answer yes or no for each required object, count, color, and relative position. A prompt passes when at least two judges approve all its requirements. For text knowledge, we use 300 MMLU-Pro test questions [ 43 ] drawn at random with seed 0 and select the option whose letter is the most likely first reply token. Our rule written before evaluation defines a skill as harmed when the 95% paired bootstrap interval for its change lies entirely below zero. By this rule, lens tuning harms neither measure in any model, and all six of its intervals include zero ( Tab. S19 ). Ordinary drawing supervision, in contrast, lowers GenEval by 23.3 points in BAGEL, mostly on prompts with two objects or a relative position.
blocks.zh: 对于每个模型,我们比较文本监督的训练种子0,普通的绘图监督,以及镜头与未经过训练的模型的调谐,使适配器在整个评价过程中一直活跃,包括绘图. 对于图像生成,我们从GenEval的六类中的每一类[16]随机选择20个提示,然后评估任何检查点,并使用每个模型的普通文本到图像路径及其默认设置和绘制种子 0绘制每个提示一张图片. 我们的三位裁判取代了 GenEval 的天体探测器, 对每个需要的天体、计数、颜色和相对位置回答是或否。 至少两名法官批准其所有要求后,即刻通过。 对于文本知识,我们使用 300 MMLU-Pro 测试问题 [43] 随机抽取的种子 0,并选择其字母最有可能是第一个回复符号的选项. 在评估前写成的规则将技能定义为在95%的配对靴子间隔完全低于零时受到伤害。 根据这一规则,镜头调谐在任何模型中都不进行伤害度量,其所有6个间隔都包含0(Tab. S19 ). 相比之下,普通的绘图监督将GenEval在BAGEL中降低了23.3分,大多在带有两个对象或相对位置的提示上.

blocks.en: F.4 State questions and answer changes
blocks.zh: F.4 国家问答变化

blocks.en: Lens tuning also changes answers to questions about an object’s state after an event. Each scenario has two stories, one in which the change happens and one in which it is prevented, followed by a question with two answer options asked in both orders. Both models use the same 40 scenarios, giving 80 stories. The object is named in the question, as in Is the slice of bread now white or brown? Twenty of the scenarios were added to an earlier set under the same writing rules and selected from screened candidates using a rule fixed before training. A second set of 28 scenarios (56 stories) uses questions about it for the interchange test of Sec. F.5 . We supervise the question’s subject at the insertion layer in the model’s answer format.
blocks.zh: Lens 调试也会改变对事件后对象状态的回答. 每个场景有两个故事,一个是变化发生的故事,一个是防止变化的故事,然后是两个顺序中都有两个答案选项的问题. 两种模型都采用相同的40种情景,给出80个故事. 物体在问题中被命名,就像在面包片现在是白色还是棕色一样? 其中20个设想方案是根据相同的书写规则在先前的一套方案中增加的,并使用培训前固定的规则从经过筛选的候选人中挑选出来的。 第二组28场景(56场故事)使用与此相关的问题进行Sec.F.5的交换测试. 我们在模型的答案格式的插入层监督问题的主题。

blocks.en: The HunyuanImage-3.0 checkpoint has 80B parameters, 13B active parameters, and 32 transformer layers shared by text generation and image denoising. We use insertion layer 9, selected by the concrete-word calibration of Appendix A . For text generation, we use the system instruction Answer every question with exactly one word. Never explain your answer. Rank-8 LoRA adapters with scaling 16 modify layers 0 to 26 in Show-o2 and layers 0 to 8 in HunyuanImage-3.0. They act on the attention and feed-forward projections in Show-o2 and on the attention and shared MLP projections in HunyuanImage-3.0. The adapters act only while reading the source text, and the drawing request and image generator use the frozen weights.
blocks.zh: HunyuanImage-3.0检查站有80B参数,13B活性参数,32个变压器层由文本生成和图像解析共享. 我们使用附录A的混凝土字校准所选择的插入层9。 对于文本生成,我们使用系统指令 用一个字回答每个问题。 永远别解释你的答案 Rank-8 LoRA适配器,在Show-o2中缩放16个修改层0至26个,在HunyuanImage-3.0. 它们在Show-o2中的注意和反馈预测以及HunyuanImage-3.0中的注意和共享的MLP预测中发挥作用。 适配器只在读取源文本时行动,绘图请求和图像生成器使用冷冻重量.

blocks.en: Each target is the frozen model’s own drawing of a photo of a { state } , with four target pictures per state in Show-o2 and two in HunyuanImage-3.0. The right-state objective uses the state implied by the story, and the wrong-state objective uses the alternative state of the same scenario. Both apply the denoising loss defined in the main paper through the subject’s hidden state carried by the V-lens . AdamW uses learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , no weight decay, and batches of eight texts. We train both models for 600 updates with each target. Every setting uses training seeds 0, 1, and 2. Each loss evaluation samples a target picture, fresh noise, and a noise level uniformly on [ 0.4 , 1 ] [0.4,1] . HunyuanImage-3.0 uses noised image latents with timestep 1000 ​ t 1000t and target ϵ − z \epsilon-z , and its target pictures are generated at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 pixels.
blocks.zh: 每个目标都是被冻结的模型自己绘制的{状态}照片,每个状态在Show-o2中有四个目标照片,在HunyuanImage-3.0. 右状态目标使用故事所暗示的状态,错误状态目标使用同一种情景的替代状态. 两者都通过V-lens所携带的主体隐藏状态适用主纸中定义的去名损失。 AdamW使用学习率 10 - 4 10 - 4 10 - 4 },无重量衰减,分批8个文本. 我们为每个目标培训600个更新模型。 每个设置都使用0,1和2训练种子. 每项损失评估都对目标图、新鲜噪音和[0.4,1][0.4,1]上的统一噪音水平进行取样。 HunyuanImage-3.0使用带有时间步1000 t 1000t和目标QQ − z\epsilon-z的噪声图像潜伏,其目标图片生成时间为1024×1024 1024\times 1024像素.

blocks.en: A story is answered correctly when the greedy one-word replies to the question in both option orders name the right option, and Tab. S20 also reports each order separately. We ask every question in both orders because the models prefer one option position. Untrained Show-o2 answers 48 of the 80 stories correctly as written and 53 with the options reversed, so a single order mixes the story’s effect with this preference. Requiring both orders, or averaging the answer margin over both orders as Fig. 8 does, removes it. In the state-question experiment, the pictures of the subject’s hidden state use drawing seed 0 at the insertion layer. A picture is correct when two of the three judges choose the right state in the main-subject question of Appendix B , whose options are the scenario’s two states, both, and neither. The figure’s two-option probability is 1 / ( 1 + exp ⁡ ( − m ) ) 1/(1+\exp(-m)) , where m m is the preferred option’s log-probability margin at the first reply token, averaged over both option orders.
blocks.zh: 当贪婪的单字回答两个选项中的问题时,一个故事被正确回答,命令命名正确的选项,Tab. S20还分别报告每个订单. 我们问两个顺序中的每一个问题,因为模型偏爱一个选项位置。 未经训练的Show-o2正确回答80个故事中的48个,以及53个选项倒置,因此一个单次顺序将故事的效果与这种偏好混合. 要求两个命令,或者像图8那样平均两个命令的回答比值,将其删除. 在状态问题实验中,被试者隐藏状态的图片使用插入层绘制种子 0. 当三位法官中的两位在附录B中选择正确的状态时, 数字的双选项概率是 1 / (1 + exp ⁡ (− m)) 1/ (1+\ exp (-m)),其中 m m是首选选项在首个回复符时的对数概率比值,平均高于两个选项命令.

blocks.en: Table S20: State-question results for every training seed on the same 80 stories for both models, with lens tuning toward the right or wrong state. The counts show stories with correct one-word replies as written, reversed, and in both orders, and stories pictured correctly.
blocks.zh: 表S20: 数据类型: 每一个培训种子都得到国家质疑的结果 80个故事的相同 两个模型, 镜头调整对错状态。 计数显示有正确单词回答的故事是书面的,反转的,并按顺序排列,故事的画面正确.

blocks.en: Right-state pictures raise Show-o2’s correct answers, while wrong-state pictures leave them near the untrained level. Lens tuning with right-state pictures gives 33 to 48 stories answered correctly in both orders, and wrong-state pictures give 27 to 28, against 29 before training ( Tab. S20 ). The pictures after wrong-state tuning show the assigned alternative in 53, 49, and 56 of the 80 stories across the three training seeds, compared with 33 before training. In HunyuanImage-3.0, right-state lens tuning gives 36 to 45 stories answered correctly in both orders and wrong-state tuning gives 36 to 42, against 32 before training, so training raises its answers whichever state the pictures show. Its pictures after wrong-state tuning show the assigned alternative in 34, 37, and 37 of the 80 stories, compared with 24 before training. In Show-o2, the avocado, butter, caterpillar, hen’s egg, and pine stories change from a wrong reply to the right one in both option orders and show the right state in all three right-state runs, and four more stories do so in two. In HunyuanImage-3.0, the marshmallow, pizza, and sandcastle stories do so in all three runs, and nine more do so in two.
blocks.zh: 右态图片提升Show-o2的正确答案,而错误态图片则使其接近未训练的级别. 以右态图片调试的镜头给出了33至48个故事在命令中正确回答,错误态图片给出了27至28个,而在训练前则给出了29个(Tab. S20 ). 错误状态调制后的图片显示,在三个训练种子的80个故事中,有53个,49个和56个被指定选择,而培训前只有33个。 在HunyuanImage-3.0中,右状态镜头调制给出了36至45个故事的顺序正确回答,错误状态调制给出了36至42个,而在训练前则给出了32个,因此训练在图片显示的状态中提出了答案. 其错误状态调制后的图片在80个故事中的34个,37个和37个故事中显示了指定选项,而培训前只有24个. 在Show-o2中,鳄梨、黄油、毛虫、母鸡的蛋和松子故事从两个选项命令中错误的回答变为正确的回答,并在所有三个右州跑中显示正确的状态,还有四个故事是用两个。 在HunyuanImage-3.0中,棉花糖,比萨饼,和砂卡斯尔的故事在所有三跑中都这样做,还有9个在两跑中这样做.

blocks.en: F.5 Interchanging the subject’s hidden states
blocks.zh: F.5 联合国 更改主题的隐藏状态

blocks.en: For the second set of 56 stories, we carry the trained subject word’s hidden states from each of the three Show-o2 donors lens-tuned on these stories into the untrained model while it answers the identical question. At each layer from 0 to 27, the subject’s hidden state is replaced by its raw state from the trained model’s reading of that text. All other token positions are recomputed by the untrained model while no adapters are active. We use both option orders and repeat the intervention for all three trained models. blocks.en: All items were drafted and checked as text before any picture was drawn, and the exact texts are stored with the code. Table S22 shows one example from each of the item sets described here. The matched descriptions (30 pairs) are questions whose description of an object ends in a part word shared by both objects of the pair. Neither object is named, and each question asks for a short factual answer. The two objects are distinct main subjects rather than a part and its whole. The pronoun pairs (20 pairs) name two things and then select one with a verb. Ten pairs change the verb while keeping both things, and ten keep the verb while changing one of the things. The items with two meanings (20 words) use one word twice in a sentence, with the selecting context before each occurrence, in both orders. The 16 depth-study questions each include a preceding sentence that names the object and an alternative object for the judges. The two-state items pair objects that share two color or pattern values, with one two-sentence text per value that mentions the object and later refers to it with it , and one plain sentence per value that names both the object and the value.

blocks.en: The V-lens depends on what the model’s generator can draw. We study objects, colors, and visible states, and do not establish reliable readings of numbers, relations, or abstract ideas. Each reading also requires generating a full image, taking 9–110 seconds in our setup. A missing picture does not establish that a hidden state lacks the concept, as the untrained pronoun results illustrate. Our scores depend on three multimodal judges choosing among a few options, and calibration and human checks cannot rule out acceptance of similar but incorrect objects. The item sets are small and mostly written by hand, with 16 two-hop questions, 30 description pairs, 20 two-meaning words, 20 pronoun pairs, 16 two-state pairs, 40 state scenarios, and 28 interchange scenarios, in addition to the lens-variant sets of Sec. A.3 . Recovery of unnamed objects is modest and is not significantly above chance in BAGEL or SenseNova-U1. The best later token in Fig. 4 selects among many positions for each question and layer, so its curve is a descriptive summary.
blocks.zh: V-lens 取决于模型的生成器能绘制什么 。 我们研究物体,颜色,和可见的状态,不建立可靠的数字读数,关系,或抽象的想法. 每次读数也需要产生完整的图像,需要9-110秒的设定. 如未经训练的代词结果所示,缺失的图片并不能确定隐藏状态缺乏这一概念. 我们的分数取决于三名多式联运法官在几种选择中作出选择,而校准和人为检查不能排除接受类似但错误的对象。 物品集小,多为手工写作,除镜头变种集Sec. A.3外,还有16个双跳题,30个描述对,20个双意词,20个代词对,16个双态对,40个状态假想,28个交换假想. 未命名物体的回收量不大,在BAGEL或SenseNova-U1中并不明显高于机会. Fig. 4中最好的后期符号在很多位置中选择每个问题和层,因此其曲线是一个描述性摘要.

blocks.en: Lens tuning trains hidden states through the same lens used to evaluate them. Gains in ordinary drawing are small, and word state supervision without pictures exceeds lens tuning on unseen phrases in SenseNova-U1 and on unseen nouns and phrases in HunyuanImage-3.0. The gains in text answers correspond to about ten stories out of 80 and are measured on the supervised stories. The interchange test transfers whole hidden states and has no control donor trained on different picture targets, so it does not isolate the contribution of the pictured content. Finally, the general capability checks use one training seed, and their intervals still allow losses of several percentage points.
